nodes.text: All the things that move you, all in our Premium Economy | 特選經濟客艙的匠心設計 全為昇華你的每段旅程

Treat yourself to a refined experience in our Premium Economy^. Enjoy the privilege of priority boarding and settle into your spacious seat 💺, designed for comfort once onboard. Immerse yourself in our award-winning inflight entertainment 🎬, while savouring specially curated delicacies in collaboration with our partnering restaurant, Yat Tung Heen* 🥢. Premium Economy brings all the things that move you, all in one place ✈️. Your extraordinary journey begins the moment you take off: https://bit.ly/3Ge7P3v ^Product services may vary depending on routes and aircraft configuration. Terms and conditions apply. *Available on selected flights only. #cathaypacific #MoveBeyond 選乘特選經濟客艙^，以一段精彩旅程犒賞自己。由優先登機一刻起，尊貴體驗等你一一發掘——安坐寬敞舒適座椅💺，盡享寬闊伸展空間；一邊沉浸於我們屢獲殊榮的機上娛樂🎬，一邊細味與米芝蓮星級食府逸東軒合作的機上美饌* 🥢，全程享受升級飛行體驗。從每個心思細節出發，特選經濟客艙讓你盡享愜意自在的空中旅程 ✈️。 非凡旅程，由起飛一刻悠然啟航：https://bit.ly/44hBFgA ^產品服務可能因航線及客機配置而有所不同。受條款及細則約束。 *只適用於指定航班。 #國泰航空 #志在飛躍
with inflight dining by Michelin-starred restaurant, Yat Tung Heen*
聯拍米芝蓮星級食府逸東軒* 呈獻機上美食
寬大傾斜角度及充裕伸展空間
ALL THE THINGS THAT MOVE YOU
全為昇華你的每段旅程
